sampleValues.Harbor Defenses & Reefs: Accessible only through the Knife-Tooth Channel at half-flood tide; brass sea-chains rise from two twin lighthouses.
sampleValues.Port Authority / Pirate Lords:
Captain Mara Vance | The Iron Albatross | Drydocks & Rope-Walk
Old Kess | Lantern Syndicate | Floating Bazaar
sampleValues.Port Code & Parley Rules: No cannon fire inside the red mooring buoys; debts drawn in salt-ink are enforceable by any captain present.
sampleValues.Contraband Specialties: Forbidden Tomes, Forged Letters of Marque, Exotic Poisons
sampleValues.Famous Taverns & Safehouses: The Drowned Compass—built inside the upturned hull of an elven galleon.
sampleValues.Tidal & Seasonal Hazards: Autumn Ghost-Fogs swallow ships whose bells aren't wrapped in kelp-cloth.
